arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-01' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: This counts every transaction dated in October 2019, which is the last month in the data.
assumptions: "Last month" is measured from the last day of the data (2019-10-31), so it means October 2019: 2019-10-01 up to but not including 2019-11-01.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label, an error, or a negative amount.
